profile.description: NetLogo 7.0.4 in-memory rendering profile at similarity threshold 0.8 and final tick 500. Every action advances the Schelling model, recolors patches, and paints the headless view to a BufferedImage. The final image is validated against NetLogo state and encoded once outside the timed interval; no measured action includes PNG encoding or file I/O.

dimensions.rendering: HeadlessWorkspace.exportView() to BufferedImage after every action; final PNG encoding outside timing; no file I/O
